definitions.possession: Independent played attacking episode; same-team free throws and retained rebounds continue it. Raw canonical IDs, no-touch fragments, period splits and recalled-advantage aliases are reported separately.
definitions.shots: totalAttempts is all actors/all shot types; fieldAttempts excludes 7m and goalkeeper attempts; outfieldAttempts includes7m but excludes keepers. Conversions require action-linked category goals, not inferred total-goal subtraction.
definitions.loss: Exactly one exclusive terminal loss cause per played episode. A failed reception can be retained; an earlier released shot does not erase a later loss. Incident pass flags overlap and are not added to terminal losses.
definitions.sevenMetres: Independent shot/episode flag, not an additional exclusive ending; report its goals/attempts separately.
definitions.Frikast: Distinct attacking WHISTLE_RESTART FREE_THROW/foulId only; excludes 7m, realized advantage, assessments, administrative awards and timeout. NO_REFERENCE.
definitions.duration: Elapsed official-clock episode seconds; no empirical exact-duration reference. NO_REFERENCE.
definitions.officialTechnicalErrors: NO_DIRECT_COMPARISON: official recorded pass/lost-ball/rule totals are not proven equivalent to engine broad losses, named fumbles, execution candidates or narrow technical-rule endings.
definitions.contexts: Raw sample-weighted actor snapshots and named failed/(received+failed) incidents, with UNRECORDED values preserved. ActionId-joined release difficulty is explicitly not intrinsic catch difficulty.

freeThrows.definition: Distinct WHISTLE_RESTART kind FREE_THROW/foulId, attacking owner. Excludes 7m, assessments, realized advantage, timeout/admin/technical FREE_THROW awards and horn retakes.

episodeDistributions.passCountDefinition: passesBeforeShot is total released passes in a shot-bearing episode, not an ordered before-last-shot count; passesBeforeLoss is the full eventually-lost episode pass count. Raw records do not expose individual shot timestamps here.

technicalContexts.definition: Raw post-event actor snapshots; sample-weighted sums, never unweighted means of match means. Failed/(received+failed) counts named reception incidents, including own-recovered fumbles, and is not terminal possession loss. INTERCEPTION snapshots describe the intercepting actor, not the losing passer.

diagnosticBands.fatigue: SEVERE energy<.3 or (energy<.4 and acute>.35); READY energy>=.7 and acute<.35; otherwise MODERATE
diagnosticBands.status: Developer diagnostic labels, not physiological or empirical thresholds

technicalContexts.difficultyDefinition: difficulty is the value actually recorded on that event; catch difficulty is normally UNRECORDED. releaseDifficulty explicitly joins that actionId to PASS_RELEASED and labels throw difficulty, not intrinsic catch difficulty.
technicalContexts.riskDefinition: Recorded risk is available only on RECEPTION_FAILED. Mean recorded failed-catch risk is not an average risk over all catches or a predicted failure rate.

secondaryCycles.unit: Existing secondary observer groups canonical possession IDs; not reconstructed period/recall-aware played episodes. Do not divide these counts by played episodes as if identical.

threats.limitation: Raw per-ID samples unavailable; per-match summary quantiles are not pooled

advantages.limitation: Raw per-ID samples unavailable; per-match summary quantiles are not pooled

recoveries.limitation: Raw per-ID samples unavailable; per-match summary quantiles are not pooled

comparison.definition: Retained benchmark totals, historical source reread, current canonical raw-ID records and independent period/recall-aware played episodes are distinct. Historical losses subtotal excludes shot-bearing losses; historical UI broad losses include every classified terminal loss. Period split/recall aliases alter units, not simulation trajectory.

freeThrows.definition: Distinct WHISTLE_RESTART kind FREE_THROW/foulId, attacking owner. Excludes 7m, assessments, realized advantage, timeout/admin/technical FREE_THROW awards and horn retakes.

episodeDistributions.passCountDefinition: passesBeforeShot is total released passes in a shot-bearing episode, not an ordered before-last-shot count; passesBeforeLoss is the full eventually-lost episode pass count. Raw records do not expose individual shot timestamps here.

technicalContexts.definition: Raw post-event actor snapshots; sample-weighted sums, never unweighted means of match means. Failed/(received+failed) counts named reception incidents, including own-recovered fumbles, and is not terminal possession loss. INTERCEPTION snapshots describe the intercepting actor, not the losing passer.

diagnosticBands.fatigue: SEVERE energy<.3 or (energy<.4 and acute>.35); READY energy>=.7 and acute<.35; otherwise MODERATE
diagnosticBands.status: Developer diagnostic labels, not physiological or empirical thresholds

technicalContexts.difficultyDefinition: difficulty is the value actually recorded on that event; catch difficulty is normally UNRECORDED. releaseDifficulty explicitly joins that actionId to PASS_RELEASED and labels throw difficulty, not intrinsic catch difficulty.
technicalContexts.riskDefinition: Recorded risk is available only on RECEPTION_FAILED. Mean recorded failed-catch risk is not an average risk over all catches or a predicted failure rate.

secondaryCycles.unit: Existing secondary observer groups canonical possession IDs; not reconstructed period/recall-aware played episodes. Do not divide these counts by played episodes as if identical.

threats.limitation: Raw per-ID samples unavailable; per-match summary quantiles are not pooled

advantages.limitation: Raw per-ID samples unavailable; per-match summary quantiles are not pooled

recoveries.limitation: Raw per-ID samples unavailable; per-match summary quantiles are not pooled

comparison.definition: Retained benchmark totals, historical source reread, current canonical raw-ID records and independent period/recall-aware played episodes are distinct. Historical losses subtotal excludes shot-bearing losses; historical UI broad losses include every classified terminal loss. Period split/recall aliases alter units, not simulation trajectory.

integrity.note: Raw integrity fields are retained even when they are observations rather than failures. Cross-ID recalls and procedural/period differences require the reconciliation metadata; no anomaly is silently discarded.

unsupported: OFFENSIVE_FOUL has no current canonical producer; zero is not proof of modeled offensive fouls.
No distinct dribble/control-error lottery; unspecified open-play recovery is not an attributed technical error.
Official HBL technical errors have no proven one-to-one mapping to these engine categories.
Pass success can involve multiple explanatory events; pass incident flags overlap, broad losses do not.
